title: Syntomic cohomology of truncated Brown--Peterson spectra
summary: We compute the $\mathrm{MU}$-based syntomic cohomologies, mod $(p,v_1,\cdots,v_n)$, of all $\mathbb{E}_1$ $\mathrm{MU}$-algebra forms of the truncated Brown--Peterson spectrum $\mathrm{BP}\langle n\rangle$. As qualitative consequences, we resolve the Lichtenbaum--Quillen, telescope, and redshift questions for the algebraic K-theories of all $\mathbb{E}_{1}$ $\mathrm{MU}$-algebra forms of $\mathrm{BP} \langle n\rangle$.
